name: Wifiskeleton
description:
'''Jeremiah Justin Simms''' (July 24, 2003 – May 5, 2025), known professionally as '''Wifiskeleton''' (stylized in all [[Letter case|lowercase]]), was an American musician and [[YouTuber]]. He was a co-founder of the underground collective [[List of Internet rap collectives#GothAngelz|GothAngelz]].

Born in [[Atlanta]], Georgia, Wifiskeleton initially gained popularity through a commentary [[YouTube]] channel under the name "Cyrus" in the late 2010s. Around this time, he made music as "Fuxkcy", "Secretsaturdays", and "*67". In 2022, he shifted to rock music under the name "Wifiskeleton". Eventually, he became a leading figure in [[SoundCloud indie]].

In 2025, Wifiskeleton died due to a suspected [[drug overdose]], which led to his single "Nope Your Too Late I Already Died" going viral worldwide and posthumously earning him over eight million monthly listeners on [[Spotify]]. The song was certified [[RIAA certification|platinum]] by the [[Recording Industry Association of America|Recording Industry Association of America]] (RIAA), and reached number 91 on the US [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]]. It also appeared on several music charts around the world.
